# Define a function to identify consecutive anomaly sub-series (faults) for a given filtered metric DataFrame and its anomalies
def identify_faults(filtered_df, anomalies_df, p95_df, component_col='cmdb_id'):
    # Merge filtered data with p95 thresholds on component and KPI name
    merged = filtered_df.merge(p95_df, on=[component_col, 'name'], how='left')
    # Filter only anomaly points (value > p95_threshold)
    merged = merged[merged['value'] > merged['p95_threshold']].copy()
    if merged.empty:
        return pd.DataFrame(columns=[component_col, 'name', 'fault_start', 'fault_end', 'max_threshold_breach'])

    # Sort by component, KPI, and datetime
    merged.sort_values(by=[component_col, 'name', 'datetime'], inplace=True)

    # Calculate threshold breach ratio = (value - p95_threshold) / p95_threshold
    # Handle p95_threshold == 0 by setting breach ratio to a large number if value > 0
    merged['threshold_breach'] = (merged['value'] - merged['p95_threshold']) / merged['p95_threshold']
    merged.loc[merged['p95_threshold'] == 0, 'threshold_breach'] = np.where(
        merged.loc[merged['p95_threshold'] == 0, 'value'] > 0, np.inf, 0)

    # Identify consecutive anomaly groups by checking if the time difference between consecutive points is <= 1 minute (60 seconds)
    # Create a group id for consecutive anomalies
    merged['time_diff'] = merged.groupby([component_col, 'name'])['datetime'].diff().dt.total_seconds()
    merged['new_group'] = (merged['time_diff'] > 60) | (merged['time_diff'].isna())
    merged['group_id'] = merged.groupby([component_col, 'name'])['new_group'].cumsum()

    # Aggregate faults by group_id
    faults = merged.groupby([component_col, 'name', 'group_id']).agg(
        fault_start=('datetime', 'min'),
        fault_end=('datetime', 'max'),
        max_threshold_breach=('threshold_breach', 'max'),
        count=('threshold_breach', 'size')
    ).reset_index(drop=False)

    # Filter out isolated spikes (count == 1)
    faults = faults[faults['count'] > 1]

    # Filter out faults where max threshold breach <= 50% (0.5)
    faults = faults[faults['max_threshold_breach'] > 0.5]

    # Select relevant columns
    faults = faults[[component_col, 'name', 'fault_start', 'fault_end', 'max_threshold_breach']]

    return faults
